cells.remarks: Eulogises the family of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Tribhuvana-malla, Mallidēva-Chōḷa-Mahārāja, son of Irungōladēva and Bammaladēvi, who was the son of Irungōladēva, and states that he had set up the gods Mallikarjunadēva, Lōkēśvaradēva, Irungōladēvadēva, Mahādēvaradēva and Sōryadēva at Malayanur in Sire-nāḍu and granted some lands round the village (boundaries given) and also some tolls (sunka and herivāya) collected from the village, for offerings, lamp, worship and repairs to the five temples.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a plain called Barābahaḍikallaguḍde in the same hamlet (on the west side of the road to Uḍupi).
cells.remarks: Records that when Balamina-Vodeya was governing the provinces Bārkūru-rājya, Nanna, Panna and other citizens of Bārkūru-rājya, gave a piece of land in Barābahaḍikallaguḍde, (specified), to Śrī Narasiṁha-Bhārati-Vodeya of Śrigeri. Also states that certain lands were granted to the same personage for the worship of the Kapila god Kōteśvara, and the worship of the god Viṣhṇu of Baḷukku, by Baḷukkuṇṇayurya, the king's capital, and made some gifts of gold etc. in the presence of the ministers and grand-fathers (of the king), Manasāgōpa a brother-pauji (of the king). Damaged. Seema to register a grant. Built in at the bottom. Damaged. Seema to register a grant of land for the regular worship of the god Kōteśvara.
